visualCharacteristics.variantDescriptor: Large background image (map) with circular hotspots positioned by left/top percentages; clicking a hotspot opens its video or viewer in a modal.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Interactive image map that launches media

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image; then one row per hotspot: cell 1 media link (video /play URL or Dynamic Media viewer URL), cell 2 left position %, cell 3 top position %
contentPattern.description: Interactive hotspot map: large Iceland map image with 6 positioned circular hotspots; each hotspot opens a Dynamic Media video (5 mp4 play URLs, 1 DimensionalViewer URL).

usage: Use for an image (map, product shot) with clickable points that each open a video or interactive viewer.
reuseGuidance: Reuse whenever positioned clickable points over one image open media. Positions are percentages of the image width/height so they scale with it.
